transcript: Speaker A: What is the exact reason for ignoring my calls? I have been standing with your courier at your location for 30 minutes, waiting for you while you remain unreachable. My time is valuable too. Come immediately and collect your package, or I will be forced to mark your delivery unsuccessful. Speaker B: आति हूँ आति हूँ [I'm coming, I'm coming] अरे भैया, आपका गुस्सा देखकर तो मैं डर ही गई थी। और हाँ, वो भी इतनी fluent English में! कैसे बोल लेते हो इतनी अच्छी English? [Oh brother, I got scared seeing your anger. And that too in such fluent English! How do you speak such good English?] Speaker A: मैम जब से English में बोलना सीखा है ना, तब से मुझे जब भी customer पे गुस्सा आता है, तो मैं उसपे English में ही चिल्ला देता हूँ। customer भी सोचने लगता है कि कोई बहुत बड़ा officer आया है delivery करने। हाँ हाँ, आपको तो पता ही है कि आजकल English बोलने वालों की ही इज़्ज़त है। [Ma'am, ever since I learned to speak English, whenever I get angry at a customer, I just yell at them in English. The customer also starts thinking that some big officer has come to deliver. Yes, yes, you know that nowadays only English speakers get respect.] Speaker B: लेकिन ये बताओ, तुमने इतनी अच्छी English बोलना सीखी कहाँ से? English Seekho App? मैं कुछ समझी नहीं। [But tell me, where did you learn to speak such good English? English Seekho App? Where experts teach understanding and speaking English from the very basic level. And what to say about its AI coach! It is available 24/7 to practice speaking in English. I have learned to speak English with the help of English Seekho App's AI coach and expert. Anyway, here is your courier, I am getting very late. Now what are you guys looking at me for? Go download English Seekho App and learn to speak English.] Speaker C: तो install button पे click करो और English Seekho App download करो। [So click on the install button and download English Seekho App.]
